enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Spikes: This effect causes this shield to do an extra 4d6 Piercing damage when it is used to shield bash.
Greater Thorn Guard: This armor stings those that attack the wearer, causing 2d6 piercing damage on a successful melee attack.
Shield Bashing +15%: +15% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Greater Heroism: Passive: +4 morale bonus to all your attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. Does not grant immunity to Fear.
